single_image.name: massing
single_image.hint: Build only primary solids, primary voids/recesses, plinth and source-matched camera. No repeated floors, facade grids, trees or context.

single_image.name: archetypes
single_image.hint: Build each representative reusable component as a visually complete source-matched kit, including its repeatable window, balcony, railing, frame and shadow detail. Register the component and its reusable detail systems. Do not distribute it yet.

single_image.name: replication
single_image.hint: Instance only the accepted archetypes into the repeated level system. Keep first/last/transition levels out of the array.

single_image.name: variants
single_image.hint: Build source-visible non-repeating levels: podium/entry, transfer, setbacks, roof and major unique recesses. Do not add finish dressing.

single_image.name: facade_detail
single_image.hint: Add source-visible one-off details that do not belong inside reusable archetypes: entrance, canopy, crown, podium interface, corner closure, transfer joint or other unique termination. Do not rebuild repeated facade systems here.

single_image.name: finish
single_image.hint: Add restrained materials, roof/ground closure and subordinate context. Do not use landscaping or a flattering camera to hide an unresolved building.

cad.name: source_alignment
cad.hint: Build source-aligned low-detail geometry only; preserve count, XY, footprint, rotation and host relationships.

cad.name: archetypes
cad.hint: Build visually complete reusable level/component prototypes, including their repeatable source-visible detail, without broad replication.

cad.name: replication
cad.hint: Instance validated reusable definitions while preserving source transforms and footprints.

cad.name: variants
cad.hint: Build source-specific termination, roof, podium and one-off variants.

cad.name: facade_detail
cad.hint: Build and register source-visible one-off details and closures that cannot be represented by the reusable component system.

cad.name: finish
cad.hint: Add finish detail and materials without changing validated source alignment.

refinement.name: correction_scope
refinement.hint: Apply only the named high-impact correction scope; do not rebuild unrelated accepted geometry.

refinement.name: primary_corrections
refinement.hint: Correct host contacts, dimensions, hierarchy and major form defects.

refinement.name: component_cleanup
refinement.hint: Repair reusable definitions, unique variants and termination conditions.

refinement.name: finish
refinement.hint: Complete restrained finish corrections and delivery evidence.

attribution.name: attribution
attribution.hint: Create only the explicitly requested ADAI attribution text; inspect literal text, Chinese glyphs, extrusion and placement before review.

geometry_adapter.verification: Formal wrapper records source mappings and phase registrations; live SketchUp execution and visual review remain required.

instance_translation_patch.scope: internal engineering: unique managed instance translation only
